status: candidate: not installed anywhere, not peer-negotiated
extends: rtgip/2-refusal-policy/1 (the Gateway ingress mapping in src/lib/gateway/rtgip2/handler.server.ts refusalStatus, GW-F6)
rule: Everything inherited keeps its status and meaning. A permanent refusal never looks retryable; 503 is reserved for outcomes whose durability is unknown, for a node that cannot sign, and for a local verification fault where nothing was written and a retry is safe.

inherited_receipt_query.note: The receipt-query endpoint (queryRefusalStatus) maps these differently from the ingress; rtgip/3-receipt-query/2 keeps that mapping.

added_meaning.protocol_not_accepted: the connection's accept set does not contain the presented protocol
added_meaning.key_not_pinned: the key row exists but its fingerprint is not in RTGIP3_KEY_PINS, or the stored fingerprint is not sha256(public_key)
added_meaning.signature_malformed: not 128 lowercase hex, or S is not below the group order L
added_meaning.origin_missing: a forward carries no rtgip-origin header
added_meaning.origin_bad_signature: the origin signature does not verify over the source H1 message for the forwarded body
added_meaning.origin_mismatch: origin signer, key owner, envelope source or scope disagree, or the origin is not canonical JSON of exactly the six fields
added_meaning.origin_too_old: origin timestamp older than 7 days, or more than 300 s in the future
added_meaning.attest_missing: an expected role has no item, or an extra item is present
added_meaning.attest_key_mismatch: item key id or pk_sha256 disagrees with the key row or the recomputed message
added_meaning.attest_msg_mismatch: item msg_sha256 is not the digest of the message SQL recomputed
added_meaning.attest_sig_mismatch: item sig is not the signature SQL received
added_meaning.attest_stale: verified_at is not within 60 s of the database clock
added_meaning.no_signing_key: the node's signing key failed its load-time self-test or is absent; the node refuses to sign
added_meaning.admission_missing: a forward carries no rtgip-admission-receipt header; the Gateway admission is mandatory at the target
added_meaning.verification_unavailable: the only wire answer for a local verification fault (any attest_* code, a lock wait, clock skew between a node's edge and its database); the detail is logged locally

local_verdicts.note: Source-side receipt and chain verdicts. They are never HTTP responses; they decide whether a returned chain is accepted.

peer_visible.note: Codes that describe a node's own configuration or internals are never sent to a peer; the peer sees the mapped code.

added_local_only: The attest_* and key_not_pinned statuses under added are internal: they classify the local log entry and are never sent to a peer; see peer_visible.
